## Map 4 — Vault Interior (All Rooms) {.unnumbered}

**File:** `DungeonVol2Public.jpg`

**Path:** `Maptool/maps/campaign/S1_Blood_and_Omens/`

**Scenes:** Scene 2 — Entry Passage · Shield Hall · Flooded Gallery · Binding Chamber · Runic Corridor. Reuse this map for all connecting corridors. Reposition tokens between rooms. Describe architecture verbally; sketch the T-junction on paper for players.

## Map 5 — Bone Chamber (Battle Map) {.unnumbered}

**File:** `vault_s1_bone_chamber.html` (+ `vault_s1_bone_chamber.jpg`)

**Path:** `Maptool/maps/campaign/S1_Blood_and_Omens/`

**Scenes:** Scene 2 — right branch, Bone Chamber encounter

**Encounter:** 2 Ghouls + 1 Ghast (Hard for 5 players at Level 3)

Ghoul tactics: one drops from ceiling via Wall Crawl Drop (advantage on attack), one engages from floor. Party cannot shield-wall both at once. Ghast triggers Death Scream at 0 HP — DC 13 Wisdom or frightened until end of next turn.

| Token file | Who | Count / Note |
|---|---|---|
| `Ghoul.rptok` | Ceiling Ghoul | x1 — place on ceiling wall edge at start |
| `Ghoul.rptok` | Floor Ghoul | x1 — place at south entrance |
| `Ghast.rptok` | Ghast | x1 — lurking behind bone pile (center) |

---

## Map 6 — Altar Chamber (Battle Map) {.unnumbered}

**File:** `vault_s1_altar_chamber.html` (+ `vault_s1_altar_chamber.jpg`)

**Path:** `Maptool/maps/campaign/S1_Blood_and_Omens/`

**Scenes:** Scene 3 — Runic Corridor exit into the Altar Chamber

**Encounter:** 1 Wight + 2 Shadows (Deadly for 5 players at Level 3)

Wight speaks when party enters — do not start combat immediately. DC 14 Persuasion (advantage if party holds OTHALAN bone token + contract scroll) lets them exit non-lethally. On first wrong tile in Runic Corridor: Wight draws weapon, Cult Fanatic flanks, one Shadow coalesces behind altar — give the Altar Chamber guardians one free preparation round.

| Token file | Who | Count / Note |
|---|---|---|
| `Wight.rptok` | Wight guardian | x1 — at altar base, facing door |
| `Shadow.rptok` | Shadows | x2 — one each side of altar |

**On success (Persuasion DC 14):** Wight steps aside. Party retrieves the spear. Exit is the shaft at the north wall.

## Map 7 — Courtyard (Scene 4 Cult Encounter) {.unnumbered}

**File:** `vault_s1_courtyard.html` (+ `vault_s1_courtyard.jpg`)

**Path:** `Maptool/maps/campaign/S1_Blood_and_Omens/`

**Scenes:** Scene 4 — Return to the Surface. Party emerges from the hatch into the principia courtyard. Cult members have moved in above them.

**Encounter:** 1 Berserker + 2 Cultists of Mars (Easy for 5 players, depleted resources)

Cultists are not here to kill the party — they want the spear. Berserker fights; cultists attempt to grab and run. Marius Coda (the ringleader) is not present — only his men.

| Token file | Who | Count / Note |
|---|---|---|
| `Berserker.rptok` | Berserker cultist | x1 — blocks the shaft hatch |
| `Cultist_of_Mars.rptok` | Cultists of Mars | x2 — flanking positions |
| `Legionary_(Milites).rptok` | Alarmed legionaries | x4 — arrive round 3 from barracks |
| `Guard.rptok` | Gate guard | x2 — alerted; arrive round 5 |

| `handouts/handout_01_legates_orders.html` | Scene 1 — Corvinus sets wax tablet down | Slide across table without comment |
| `handouts/handout_03_omens_observed.html` | Scene 0 — Corvinus says "we lost four men" | Physical prop; players keep and annotate |

| `handouts/12_S1_entry_passage_othalan_token.pdf` | Scene 2 — Investigation DC 15 in hidden alcove | Hand to player who made the check; they share it |
| `handouts/15_S1_marcomanni_vision.pdf` | Scene 2 — first touch of boar shield | Hand face-down; say nothing |
| `handouts/16_S1_cherusci_vision.pdf` | Scene 2 — first touch of three-fingered-hand shield | Hand face-down; say nothing |
| `handouts/17_S1_suebi_vision.pdf` | Scene 2 — first touch of serpent shield | Hand face-down; say nothing |
| `handouts/18_S1_the_nine_unnamed.pdf` | Scene 2 — examine the nine smallest unmarked shields | Pause. "Nobody knows. Not even Rome." |

Handouts 01–03 are HTML (open in browser, Ctrl+P to print). Handouts 12 and 15–18 are print-ready PDFs (matching JPGs also sit alongside them in `handouts/` for on-screen display) — open directly, no browser needed.
